title: Trade Show Exhibitor List Scraper input

shows.title: Shows
shows.description: Map Your Show links or show codes, one per line. Any page of the show works, e.g. https://aapex2026.mapyourshow.com/8_0/explore/exhibitor-gallery.cfm, or just aapex2026.

includeDetails.title: Add website, phone, address and socials
includeDetails.description: Opens every exhibitor profile for website, phone, fax, address, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Instagram, booth locations, product categories and brands. Off = the exhibitor list only (name, booth, hall, description, logo), much faster and cheaper.

keyword.title: Keyword filter
keyword.description: Only exhibitors whose company name matches this word in the show's own search, e.g. software or brakes. Empty = all exhibitors.

maxResults.title: Maximum exhibitors in total
maxResults.description: Stop after this many exhibitors across all shows.
